settings.title: Git
regex.invalid: That is not a valid regular expression.
s.executable.desc: Path to the git program. Leave empty to use the one on PATH.
s.warnCrlf.desc: Before a commit, warn when staged files use CRLF.
s.warnDetachedHead.desc: Before a commit, warn when HEAD is detached or a rebase is running.
s.largeFileWarn.desc: Before a commit, warn when a staged file is bigger than the limit.
s.largeFileMb.desc: Files bigger than this trigger the warning.
s.signOff.desc: Adds a Signed-off-by line to new commits.
s.skipHooks.desc: Commits with --no-verify, so pre-commit and commit-msg hooks do not run.
s.commitCleanup.desc: How git tidies the commit message: strip comments and blank lines, trim whitespace only, or keep it as written.
s.cherryPickSuffix.desc: Appends "(cherry picked from commit …)" to the message.
s.messageHistory.desc: How many earlier commit messages the history list remembers (1 to 100).
s.forceWithLease.desc: A forced push uses --force-with-lease, which refuses to overwrite commits you have not seen.
s.autoUpdateOnReject: Update automatically when a push is rejected
s.autoUpdateOnReject.desc: Updates the branch with the update method below, then pushes again.
s.pushTags.desc: None: only the branch. Follow: tags on the commits pushed. All: every tag.
s.showPushDialog.desc: Preview the commits before they are pushed.
s.protectedBranches.desc: A regular expression: matching branches refuse force pushes. Empty protects none.
s.updateMethod.desc: How pull brings in the upstream: merge, rebase, or fast-forward only.
s.autoStash: Stash local changes around an update
s.autoStash.desc: Local changes are stashed before pull and restored after (git pull --autostash).
s.fetchTags.desc: Auto follows git's default, always also fetches every tag, never fetches none.
s.fetchPrune.desc: Removes remote-tracking branches that no longer exist on the remote.
s.logRecentCount.desc: The log shows this many recent commits at once and then loads the rest (100 to 100000).
s.logShowTags.desc: Tag labels next to commits in the log.
s.logShowRemotes.desc: Include remote-tracking branches in the log and its graph.
s.diffMode.desc: Side by side shows two columns, unified one column with + and − lines.
s.diffIgnoreWhitespace.desc: Trim: leading and trailing whitespace. All: every whitespace difference.
s.diffContext.desc: Unchanged lines shown around each change. -1 shows the whole file.
s.annotateIgnoreSpaces.desc: Whitespace-only edits do not take over a line's blame (git blame -w).
s.annotateDetectMovement.desc: Follows lines moved within a file (-M) or copied from other files (-C) to where they first came from.
s.swapSidesInRebase.desc: During a rebase git's "ours" is the branch being rebased onto. This swaps the sides so yours is on the left.
